intro:
I work with whatever materials I have the tools to process to solve whatever problem or need arises, with varying rates of success.

My projects involve everything from hand-wired keyboards and custom PCBs to 3D printing, mechanical assembly and improvised fabrication methods. 

Alongside these personal projects, I've spent several years working in software testing, support and quality assurance in the medical technology industry.

Based in Biel/Bienne, Switzerland.
